name: successor-producers
purpose: Produce the separately versioned Vulkan v2 successor after the production metadata freeze
source_authority: 4ed660bfcac535ed46ff3d092c1a9dae1213ed82; exact current runtime/source inputs must also match this commit before a producer starts
windows_native_budget_basis: The SDK-linked shutdown-native-325 leaf completed with approximately 277 MB disposable scratch. A 768 MiB declaration provides more than twice that terminal allocation for the same leaf targets, with no SDK/dependency build, source clone, environment installation or dataset. A 30-second guard must enforce both this allocation and the existing free-space reserve; stop and retain a failure if either is exceeded. This is a smaller measured leaf profile, not an override of the 20 GiB shared limit or 10 GiB reserve.
linux_ci_reason: pyproject.toml, uv.lock and src/vispy/version.py now declare v2. Existing strict production-input joins do not admit the v1 producers against these inputs. Build once on the existing managed GitHub workflow, reuse the resulting wheel on WSL, and do not duplicate the native build locally.
linux_failed_transport_basis: CI 42355088675 failed during driver preparation and exported a 5,621,151-byte artifact. A separately registered 128 MiB failure-retention transport is permitted only with a pre-extraction check that compressed plus expanded member bytes fit this allocation. This does not change the 512 MiB successful native-artifact transport declaration.
reuse: Existing qualified Windows SDK, locked CPython build preparation, exact dependency origins, Git objects and WSL interpreter/dependency sites. No pinned origin moves or mutable duplicate environment.
terminal_cleanup: Unique registered run per writable scratch root. Await owned children, preserve failures and exact original receipts/sources/licenses/artifacts, inspect and apply the registry-aware bounded plan, then verify retained hashes and scratch absence before starting another local experiment.
scope: Producer evidence only; independent source/scope reviews, installed profile admission, current CI, merge and publication remain separate. Metal remains experimental.
